description.name: Attach Earth with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Bartz (Earth)
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Master of Earth (0~2), removed after using Master of Earth two times

description.name: Master of Earth Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Master of Earth level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Bartz]

description.name: Master of Earth Level
description.text: Keeps track of Master of Earth level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Bartz]
